LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public personal-best survival run record for a signed-in player (including anonymous Firebase Auth) on the Nightfall Courtyard global Top 20 leaderboard.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

callsign.description: Public player name (3-15 letters, numbers, or spaces, zero PII).

wave.description: Highest wave reached in the recorded run (1..200).

kills.description: Total infected eliminated in the recorded run (0..1000000).

mode.description: Game mode played during the recorded run.

arena.description: Arena map selected during the recorded run.

skinId.description: Equipped operative skin ID for badge rendering.

isPublic.description: Always true; marks entry visible on public leaderboard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when player first joined the leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest personal best update.

DailyLeaderboardEntry.title: DailyLeaderboardEntry
DailyLeaderboardEntry.description: Public personal-best survival run record for a UTC Daily Seeded Challenge.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

callsign.description: Public player name (3-15 letters, numbers, or spaces).

dateKey.description: UTC date key YYYY-MM-DD matching the daily challenge.

mutator.description: Daily mutator identifier for the UTC seed.

wave.description: Wave reached in the Daily Run (1..200).

kills.description: Total infected eliminated in the Daily Run (0..1000000).

score.description: Best score achieved on this UTC day (0..100000000).

arena.description: Deterministic arena for this UTC date.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was updated.

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Public read-only Android APK release metadata stored at config/app.

downloadUrl.description: Direct APK / release download URL for native Android clients.

changelog.description: Short release notes summary displayed on the update banner.

/leaderboard/{playerId}.description: Global Top 20 personal-best high score entries keyed by authenticated player UID (including anonymous auth).

/daily_leaderboard/{dateKey}/entries/{pl.description: Daily Seeded Challenge leaderboard entries keyed by UTC date and authenticated player UID.

/config/{configId}.description: Public read-only app configuration document (config/app) for native Android update checks.
